evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I just need to know like, ten to fifteen minutes to get you an accurate quote. And then after that I can get your quote. You can depend on, does that sound good?
evidence_quotes.name_asked: Can you give me your first and last name, please? / Sure, it's Allison, A-L-I-S-O-N.
evidence_quotes.name_never_used_again: Rep never addresses Allison by name after initial collection.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moves directly to logistics without exploring customer's stated concerns about the move.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: So yeah what I'm gonna do is I will text you a link that you can join and then after that I will get you the estimate. / For how is the size it would be best if we can do a virtual walkthrough.

top_strength: Jules successfully identified that a 5,000 sq ft two-story house warranted a virtual walkthrough rather than a phone estimate, and cleanly routed Allison to the video call without abandonment.
coaching_note: Before routing to the walkthrough, Jules must ask the two-concerns question and deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) — these step into the call before probing starts on v4, not after, and must happen even on walkthrough calls.
